messages:
Mina (Security): Heads-up: new secret keying policy goes live 2026-05-01. All production signing keys must be backed by our KMS/HSM (no local private keys), with per-service key entries and automated rotation. See https://redwood.internal/sec/keying-policy. :lock:
ops-bot: Policy published: keying-policy-v2 (2026-03-28). Enforcement date: 2026-05-01.
Arjun (Crypto): Quick notes: 1) No PEM files with private keys in repos or container images. 2) Service keys should be created as KMS keys with asymmetric signing enabled where applicable. 3) Use key aliases like projects/redwood/keys/service-name-signing.
Sam (Infra): For teams still using legacy local keys (examples: experiments/metrics-signer), migration steps?
Mina (Security): Run `rctl keys import-check --owner=@team` to list local keys. Migrate by 2026-04-20. We have a helper to wrap calls: `rctl kms-sign --key=alias/service --payload=@payload` which mirrors local signing APIs so minimal code change.
Bea (Platform): We'll add an adapter library (go/python/node) that falls back to a cached short-lived signing token for high-throughput paths. Adapter PR ETA: 2026-03-30.
Sam (Infra): What about offline signing for air-gapped deployments?
Mina (Security): Air-gapped environments get a signed HSM appliance image; keys must still be managed and rotated per the policy. Request an airgap key-provisioning slot by 2026-04-10.
Arjun (Crypto): Rotation cadence: default 90-day primary key rotation, 30-day for high-risk clients. Rotation is automated for KMS keys; if you still maintain key material, submit a rotation plan.
ops-bot: Scan: found 14 repos with private PEMs in infra and integrations. Owners notified.
Bea (Platform): We'll add a pre-commit hook to detect private key blobs and fail locally to reduce accidental commits. PR coming.
Mina (Security): Please ACK in-thread when you've run the import-check and filed migration tickets. Office hours: 2026-03-31 17:00 UTC in #eng-all. If you need a hand migrating, ping @Mina or @Arjun. :white_check_mark:
